name: Caitus
desc:
Caitus is a Khan NPC. They are a member of [The Hundred Legions](faction:the_hundred_legions) and currently belonging to the 11th Scouting Legion. They stay with their group composed of [Atra](entity:atra), [Lars](entity:lars), [Gaius](entity:gaius) and [Amara](entity:amara).

Caitus tasks the player with delivering a message about a [certain someone](entity:titus_fulminus_destellus) in an [Authority Prison](location:merit_detainment_core). They will teach the Imperium Kata style to the player upon reporting back after delivering said message.

Taking upon Caitus' quest requires above Ally reputation with The Hundred Legions.
additional_info:
-   Some words said by Caitus are derived from Latin terms:
    -   Nemo is a Latin word for "nobody", which they refer to the player as under Ally reputation.
        -   Nemo was a name used in place of the Outis alias in Latinized versions of _The Odyssey_ for the hero Odysseus, who is referred to as Ulysses in the Latin version.
    -   Salve, in a Latin context, is used for greetings and farewells.
        -   Salvete is the plural form of this word, which is mostly (and incorrectly) used by Caitus.
    -   Teneō has various meanings, but in this context, may be used for "understand".
    -   Spondeō literally means "I promise".
-   You don't need to speak to Caitus before defeating Titus in order to get Imperium Kata.
